frozen_family.name: standard nondeterministic 3-CNF pigeonhole extension EPH_n^{n+1}
frozen_family.source_generator_contract: For each pigeon i, an extension chain forces at least one p(i,j); pairwise same-hole negative clauses forbid two pigeons sharing a hole.

frozen_pipeline: run existing R47M normalization stack without a projection until certified terminal or joint fixpoint
if a nonterminal joint fixpoint remains, apply exact R48Q width-4 first-certified chain policy
independently replay every selected R47M projection candidate
stop on first explicit reachable width-4 obstruction; otherwise exhaust n=4,5,6,7

width_policy.successor_requirement: verified semantic terminal OR variable-decreasing no-fresh-variable successor with persisted max width <=4
width_policy.pivot_order: canonical smallest eligible pivot, identical to R48Q

scientific_outcomes.obstruction: A standard 3-CNF PHP source reaches a certified nonterminal persisted state for which the R48Q W=4 policy has no safe certified successor, or the normalized persisted root itself already exceeds width 4.
scientific_outcomes.finite_coverage: Every frozen n=4..7 member is preterminalized or covered by a W=4 chain. This is finite evidence only and cannot prove universal W=4.
scientific_outcomes.php4_regression: The n=4 member must remain compatible with the sealed R47AD/R47AE lineage; no claim may be based on PHP4 alone.

forbidden_inference: Do not transfer proof-complexity lower bounds for bare resolution directly to TRUMP.
Do not infer universal W=4 from finite PHP coverage.
Do not infer failure of every polynomial envelope from one W=4 obstruction.
Do not infer SAT_IN_P, P_EQ_NP, or P_NE_NP.
